type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [CommSemiring R] → (σ → R) → MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R
what: Translation of multivariate polynomials by a constant vector, P(X+α).
how: Universal algebra evaluation at X j + C (α j).
hypotheses: Arbitrary independent variable/coefficient universes, commutative coefficient semiring, arbitrary translation vector; no finiteness or characteristic restrictions.

caller_summary.scope: Source-level explicit references, not opaque kernel/simp closure.

mathlib_api_audit: aeval/bind₁ yield the exact term; Polynomial.taylorAlgHom and taylorEquiv cover one variable only. Named multivariate shift not located; missing local index is not absence proof.
moral_duplications: MvPolynomial.aeval (fun j ↦ X j + C (α j))
generalization: Already maximally general in this MvPolynomial/AlgHom representation; generic substitutions already aeval. Ring-only AlgEquiv is complementary infrastructure, not weakening.
missing_api: Design question: stable named multivariate translation with Hasse coefficient, composition and inverse APIs.
junk: One-line definition with concrete semantic/API-stability exemption; no automatic deletion merely from line count.
action: Retain project-local pending upstream decision on named translation API versus direct aeval; see three concrete Phase 7 questions.
